= Camel Quarkus build items

Quarkus extensions communicate through https://quarkus.io/guides/all-builditems[build items]
produced and consumed by `@BuildStep` methods. This page is generated from the `*BuildItem`
classes in Camel Quarkus deployment modules.

Kind:

* *Simple* — at most one instance (`SimpleBuildItem`)
* *Multi* — zero or more instances (`MultiBuildItem`)
* *Empty* — a marker with no payload (`EmptyBuildItem`)

Quarkus core items such as `FeatureBuildItem` and `ReflectiveClassBuildItem` are documented on the
https://quarkus.io/guides/all-builditems[Quarkus build items] page.

Regenerate from the source tree after changing a build item:

----
./mvnw -pl tooling/maven-plugin -am install -DskipTests
./mvnw -f docs/pom.xml camel-quarkus:update-build-items-doc
----

== Core

Package: `org.apache.camel.quarkus.core.deployment.spi`

[cols="2,1,3", options="header"]
|===
|Build item |Kind |Description

|`BuildTimeCamelCatalogBuildItem`
|Simple
|-

|`CamelBeanBuildItem`
|Multi
|A MultiBuildItem holding beans to add to org.apache.camel.spi.Registry during ExecutionTime#STATIC_INIT phase. You can use the sibling CamelRuntimeBeanBuildItem to register beans in the ExecutionTime#RUNTIME_INIT phase - i.e. those ones that cannot be produced during ExecutionTime#STATIC_INIT phase. Note that the field type should refer to the most specialized class to avoid the issue described in https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/CAMEL-13948.

|`CamelBeanQualifierResolverBuildItem`
|Multi
|Holds a CamelBeanQualifierResolver for a specified bean type.

|`CamelBootClockBuildItem`
|Simple
|-

|`CamelBootstrapCompletedBuildItem`
|Empty
|A build item that does not carry any data but it is used to signal that all the bootstrap steps have been completed.

|`CamelComponentNameResolverBuildItem`
|Simple
|Holds the ComponentNameResolver RuntimeValue.

|`CamelContextBuildItem`
|Simple
|Holds the CamelContext RuntimeValue.

|`CamelContextCustomizerBuildItem`
|Multi
|A MultiBuildItem holding the CamelContextCustomizer RuntimeValue and could be used to customize the camel context before produce the CamelContextBuildItem

|`CamelFactoryFinderResolverBuildItem`
|Simple
|A SimpleBuildItem holding a FactoryFinderResolver RuntimeValue.

|`CamelModelJAXBContextFactoryBuildItem`
|Simple
|Holds the ModelJAXBContextFactory instance.

|`CamelModelReifierFactoryBuildItem`
|Simple
|A SimpleBuildItem holding a ModelReifierFactory RuntimeValue.

|`CamelModelToXMLDumperBuildItem`
|Simple
|-

|`CamelModelToYAMLDumperBuildItem`
|Simple
|-

|`CamelPackageScanClassBuildItem`
|Multi
|A MultiBuildItem holding the names of a types that will be scanned by the Camel PackageScanClassResolver.

|`CamelPackageScanClassResolverBuildItem`
|Simple
|Holds the PackageScanClassResolver RuntimeValue.

|`CamelRegistryBuildItem`
|Simple
|Holds the Registry RuntimeValue. It is made available after the beans from CamelBeanBuildItems were registered in the underlying Registry.

|`CamelRouteResourceBuildItem`
|Multi
|Holds a Resource relating to discovered Camel DSL route definition files defined by route inclusion patterns configuration.

|`CamelRoutesBuilderClassBuildItem`
|Multi
|A MultiBuildItem holding class names of all RoutesBuilder implementations. The class names are gathered from Jandex by `camel-quarkus-core`. Extensions are free to add CamelRoutesBuilderClassBuildItems programmatically.

|`CamelRoutesLoaderBuildItems.Registry`
|Simple
|Holds the RegistryRoutesLoader instance.

|`CamelRuntimeBeanBuildItem`
|Multi
|A MultiBuildItem holding beans to add to org.apache.camel.spi.Registry during ExecutionTime#RUNTIME_INIT phase. You should use the sibling CamelBeanBuildItem for all beans that can be produced during ExecutionTime#STATIC_INIT phase. Note that the field type should refer to the most specialized class to avoid the issue described in https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/CAMEL-13948.

|`CamelRuntimeBuildItem`
|Simple
|-

|`CamelRuntimeTaskBuildItem`
|Multi
|Marker used as synchronization item for Build Steps to ensure all the Build Steps that need to record ExecutionTime#RUNTIME_INIT. As example some beans can be bound to the org.apache.camel.spi.Registry at ExecutionTime#STATIC_INIT but others can only be bound at ExecutionTime#RUNTIME_INIT and to be sure that the binding happens before the org.apache.camel.quarkus.core.CamelRuntime is assembled and started a CamelRuntimeTaskBuildItem is produced and the Build Steps producing CamelRuntimeBuildItem depends on it. The initial barrier required two symmetric Build Items: CamelRegistryBuildItem CamelRuntimeRegistryBuildItem Where the second Build Item was useless except for synchronization purpose and has been replaced to this generic CamelRuntimeTaskBuildItem.

|`CamelSerializationBuildItem`
|Multi
|Signal that basic classes listed in `org.apache.camel.quarkus.core.deployment.CamelSerializationProcessor.baseSerializationClasses()` should be registered for serialization.

|`CamelServiceBuildItem`
|Multi
|A MultiBuildItem holding information about a service defined in a property file somewhere under `META-INF/services/org/apache/camel`.

|`CamelServiceFilterBuildItem`
|Multi
|-

|`CamelServicePatternBuildItem`
|Multi
|A MultiBuildItem holding a collection of path patterns to select files under `META-INF/services/org/apache/camel` which define discoverable Camel services.

|`CamelTypeConverterLoaderBuildItem`
|Multi
|Holds the TypeConverterLoader RuntimeValue.

|`CamelTypeConverterRegistryBuildItem`
|Simple
|Holds the org.apache.camel.spi.TypeConverterRegistry RuntimeValue.

|`CompiledCSimpleExpressionBuildItem`
|Multi
|A MultiBuildItem bearing info about a compiled CSimple language expression.

|`ContainerBeansBuildItem`
|Simple
|Hold a set of beans known to the ArC container.

|`RoutesBuilderClassExcludeBuildItem`
|Multi
|A MultiBuildItem holding patterns whose matching classes will be excluded from the set of classes from which routes will be instantiated. This is a programmatic way of doing the same thing as can be done via RoutesDiscoveryConfig#excludePatterns.

|`RuntimeCamelContextCustomizerBuildItem`
|Multi
|A MultiBuildItem holding the CamelContextCustomizer RuntimeValue and could be used to customize the camel context before starting it.
|===

== support-bouncycastle

[cols="2,1,3", options="header"]
|===
|Build item |Kind |Description

|`BouncyCastleAdditionalProviderBuildItem`
|Multi
|In case that non-default BC provider has to be registered, use this buildItem. (provider available for registration is `BCPQC`)

|`CipherTransformationBuildItem`
|Multi
|A MultiBuildItem holding cipher transformations to be explicitly registered as security services. Extensions should provide all cipher transformations that are reachable at runtime. Those cipher transformations will be explicitly instantiated at bootstrap so that graal can proceed with security services automatic registration.
